ELECTRICITY — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #10
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ELECTRICITY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   D. Ignore burnt cables

2. When learning D.C Electric Circuits 1.3 Cells and Batteries 1.4 Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for D.C Electric Circuits 1.3 Cells and Batteries 1.4 Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for D.C Electric Circuits 1.3 Cells and Batteries 1.4 Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after D.C Electric Circuits 1.3 Cells and Batteries 1.4 Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5.
   D. Skip safety briefings for D.C Electric Circuits 1.3 Cells and Batteries 1.4 Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5.

3. When learning Pictorial Drawings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pictorial Drawings.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Pictorial Drawings.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pictorial Drawings.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pictorial Drawings.

4. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Run with the tool

5. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Monitor
   C. Keyboard
   D. Speaker

6. When learning Cells and Batteries, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Cells and Batteries.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Cells and Batteries.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Cells and Batteries.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Cells and Batteries.

7. When learning Capacitors and Capacitance, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Capacitors and Capacitance.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Capacitors and Capacitance.

   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Capacitors and Capacitance.

8. When learning Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Installation. 3.1 Generation, Transmissi, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2..

   A. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Electricity.

12. When learning Magnetism, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. International Cricket Team

16. When learning Electro- Magnetism, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Electro- Magnetism.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Electro- Magnetism.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Electro- Magnetism.
